text:
Maria K: kicking off PROD tenant_id migration now on prod-5 window. pinned release `v2.3.1-db-mig`. please watch locks and throttles.

deploybot: migration job started id=mg-20260321-117. Running phased add-column + backfill. ETA ~45m. Logs: https://ci.redwood/migs/mg-20260321-117 :gear:

Raj P: copy — what's the live backfill rate target?

Maria K: target 10k rows/min, max burst 18k. throttle set to 12k initially. If we hit >15k sustained for 3m, engage surge-throttle (drop to 6k) and notify. :eyes:

Elaine: preflight check: read replicas healthy, replication lag < 200ms, cpu on prod-5 GPUs unaffected. i've bumped deploybot concurrency to 6 for parallel shards.

Simon: callout: the app heartbeat spikes at the start of backfill historically. if 5xx rate >0.3% in the next 10m we pause.

deploybot: mdlog: 
```
[00:00:12] starting phase=add-column tenant_id (concurrent safe)
[00:01:04] starting phase=backfill shard=3 rows=0
[00:06:40] backfill shard=3 rows=23k rate=12.2k/min
```

Elaine: shard=3 hitting planned rate. watch lock-time histogram (p95). If p95 lock time > 400ms for more than 2m, we trigger holdpoint.

Raj P: rolling metrics dashboard: https://grafana/redwood/d/mi-ops/migration-watch?orgId=1 — i've set an alert: mig.mg-117.lock_p95 > 400ms for 2m -> @ops-sre paging.

ops-sre: acknowledged. Oncall ready. If page comes, we'll coordinate emergency rollback decision tree.

Maria K: rollback criteria in this run: 1) >0.5% 5xx across API surface for 5m, or 2) lock_p95 > 400ms for 5m, or 3) replication lag > 1s for any replica for 3m. If hit, run `bin/mig-rollback --id=mg-20260321-117 --fast` and pin model to `v2.3.0`.

Simon: quick command to pause deploybot if needed: `deploybot pause mg-20260321-117 --reason "holdpoint"` — i've put it in our ops runbook.

Maria K: also added a soft-fallback route: new reads will prefer read-replica if primary lock queue > 100ms to reduce contention. routing change will be rolled back automatically after 10m if healthy.

deploybot: update: backfill progress 42% rows scanned. estimated remaining 26m. No alerts yet. :thumbsup:

Raj P: noted. I'm standing by for release-note snippet and postmortem tags. Maria, drop the release note line here so eng-comm can grab it.

Maria K: release notes blurb: "DB: tenant_id column added with phased backfill (mg-20260321-117). No schema downtime expected; rollback path available. See infra runbook for thresholds and emergency rollback steps."

ops-sre: will annotate incident playbook in case we hit holdpoint. tagging incident-channel #incidents-prod.

Elaine: small QA: running smoke check against canary traffic. No regressions observed.

deploybot: final: backfill completed for shards 1-4. finishing phase=index-validate. ETA 4m.

Maria K: great job team. keep monitoring for 10m then we'll mark as complete and unpin release.

Simon: :thumbsup: — will follow up with retention of logs for 30d and a short blameless postmortem if we hit the holdpoint.

deploybot: migration mg-20260321-117 completed successfully at ts=1759994350.
